items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Curtis Oliver. Anyway, we had trombone and two saxophones, and trumpet. So we rehearsed on the show, while we was traveling. He was getting this band together. And he booked a dance in Minneapolis. Well, we went there and played the dance, and we stayed in Minneapolis.

ctx.x: Anybody else besides those people you mentioned? Did you have a piano player?
Yeah. Curtis Oliver. That was it.
So you had piano, banjo tuba (Mr. Young), three saxophones...
